official_status_updates.finding: The official 2025-08-20 progress page records continuing control-plan compilation and an AI innovation-street draft.
official_status_updates.impact: Retained as historical progress evidence and read together with the 2024 public draft and 2026 technical-review statement.

official_status_updates.finding: The official 2024 public notice exposes a raster planning-scope map and draft summary controls for HD00-1601 and related blocks.
official_status_updates.impact: Closes the former claim that no control-plan material was public, but does not provide a competition polygon or georeferenced vector.

official_status_updates.finding: The official 2026 government work report states that the Jingzhang heritage-park corridor control plan passed technical review.
official_status_updates.impact: Updates planning status beyond compilation while preserving the distinction between technical review and final government approval.

official_status_updates.finding: The effective municipal notice lists Qinghuayuan Station former site and confirms that protection-scope and construction-control drawings are separately issued.
official_status_updates.impact: Closes the heritage-status gap but leaves the official geometry as a controlled data request.

official_status_updates.finding: The municipal implementation approval records a 23.08 ha approved construction package from Xizhimen to Zhichun Road.
official_status_updates.impact: Adds an approved implementation baseline while keeping it separate from the 53.09 ha full-corridor project profile and the competition area.

official_status_updates.finding: The municipal landscape authority records completion of the supporting project and a 30.01 ha north segment from Qinghua East Road to the North Fifth Ring Road.
official_status_updates.impact: Updates project status from procurement to completed supporting works without treating the text as an as-built polygon or final survey.

official_status_updates.finding: The government procurement notice confirms a supporting-project survey contract scope, budget and duration, but exposes no survey deliverable.
official_status_updates.impact: Shows that survey data should exist with the commissioning parties; it does not close the existing-building, municipal or safety data requests.

official_status_updates.finding: The signed main survey contract explicitly includes control survey, topographic mapping, tree survey, underground-pipeline survey and engineering survey, and names the commissioning and survey organizations.
official_status_updates.impact: Changes the gap from unknown existence to identified controlled deliverables; the public page still exposes no report, coordinates or drawings.

official_status_updates.finding: Signed main and supporting design contracts confirm scheme, preliminary and construction-drawing design and name the design organization.
official_status_updates.impact: Creates a precise data-request route without treating unpublished drawings as public or inferred geometry.

official_status_updates.finding: ODbL snapshots add clipped building, road, railway, water and POI context with source element IDs and hashes.
official_status_updates.impact: Improves concept-stage existing-condition coverage while leaving statutory, title, controlled-infrastructure and survey-accuracy gaps open.

official_status_updates.finding: Official catalog metadata identifies 502 independent 1:500 sheets intersecting the disclosed provisional site and names the Beijing Institute of Surveying and Mapping as metadata contact/distributor; sampled vector products are classified secret DWG files.
official_status_updates.impact: Changes the topographic gap from unknown availability to a precise controlled-order route without treating restricted products as open data.

official_status_updates.finding: A no-login CC BY 4.0 WorldCover COG provides a reproducible 2021 10 m land-cover clip for the provisional site.
official_status_updates.impact: Adds historical surface-cover context while retaining current-survey, statutory-control and boundary gaps.

official_status_updates.finding: The official Copernicus collection describes GLO-30 as a worldwide free-licence 1 arc-second DSM with 2011-2015 primary acquisition, EPSG:4326 horizontal and EGM2008 vertical reference; the AWS Open Data Registry exposes no-account public COGs.
official_status_updates.impact: Adds reproducible coarse historical surface elevation and slope screening while retaining the need for current bare-earth survey, engineering levels, drainage, flood and statutory geometry.

official_status_updates.finding: The official JRC page exposes v1.5 water occurrence and transition aggregates for 1984-2024 and a v1.5 2022-2024 maximum-extent layer, with unrestricted use, required attribution/citation and documented co-registration limitations.
official_status_updates.impact: Adds reproducible long-term public surface-water observation screening while retaining blue-line, drainage, flood, water-quality and current-survey requests.

official_status_updates.finding: The official CDSE STAC identifies the selected Sentinel-2B L2A product, and the AWS Open Data Registry documents a no-account COG conversion containing all original scenes; product identity was cross-checked before range extraction.
official_status_updates.impact: Adds a traceable 2026-07-15 single-scene optical, SCL, NDVI and NDWI snapshot while retaining field, survey, multi-season and regulatory data requests.

official_status_updates.finding: Overture's official release, client, building schema and attribution pages expose the 2026-07-22.0 Buildings database under ODbL; retained non-OSM records identify the published East Asian building dataset DOI as their sole source.
official_status_updates.impact: Adds a traceable open machine-derived building-footprint increment while retaining statutory, cadastral, licensed survey and building-attribute requests.

official_status_updates.finding: The official JRC page publishes GHS-BUILT-H R2023A AGBH and ANBH for epoch 2018 at 100 m Mollweide and 3 arc-second WGS84, under CC BY 4.0 with product and release-method citations.
official_status_updates.impact: Adds traceable historical gridded height and gross built-volume-density context while retaining statutory and licensed current individual-building survey requests.

official_status_updates.finding: JRC publishes GHS-OBAT R2024A as open country-level footprint attribute tables derived from Overture 2024-07-22.0 and GHSL grids, with height, function, construction epoch, area, perimeter and compactness plus explicit validation and China coverage limits.
official_status_updates.impact: Adds auditable model attributes for a rigorously matched subset of current footprints while preserving the licensed current survey and statutory-control requests.

official_status_updates.finding: 北京市规自委2026-06-12案例页将约3.95公顷蓝景丽家项目明确置于大钟寺试点片区，并记录取得土地和前期实施状态。
